'''Aleksandr Mikhaylovich Sergeyev''' ({{langx|ru|Александр Михайлович Сергеев}}; born 2 August 1955<ref name="rg">{{cite news|url=https://rg.ru/2017/09/26/prezidentom-akademii-nauk-izbran-aleksandr-sergeev.html|title=Президентом академии наук избран Александр Сергеев|date=26 September 2017|author=Yury Medvedev|publisher=[[Rossiyskaya Gazeta]]|language=Russian|accessdate=26 September 2017}}</ref>) is a Russian physicist. In 2017-2022 he was the president of the [[Russian Academy of Sciences]].<ref>{{cite news|url=http://tass.com/society/967623|title=Alexander Sergeyev becomes president of Russian Academy of Sciences|date=26 September 2017|publisher=[[TASS]]|accessdate=26 September 2017}}</ref>

Sergeev was born in [[Buturlino, Nizhny Novgorod Oblast|Buturlino]], [[Nizhny Novgorod Oblast|Gorky Oblast]]<ref name="tass_bio">{{cite web|url=http://tass.ru/info/4594221|title=Биография избранного президента РАН Александра Сергеева|date=26 September 2017|publisher=[[TASS]]|accessdate=27 September 2017}}</ref> and studied physics at [[N. I. Lobachevsky State University of Nizhny Novgorod|Gorky State University]], graduating in 1977. After the graduation, he worked as a researcher at the Institute of Applied Physics of the Russian Academy of Sciences at Gorky, currently [[Nizhny Novgorod]]. He received his PhD (Cand. Sci.) in 1982, and spent his whole scientific career at the same institute. In 2015, he became the director of the institute.<ref name="rg"/>

The main research interest of Sergeev is nonlinear phenomena in physics including [[plasma physics]] and physics of [[femtosecond laser]]s. Specifically, he guided development of petawatt-class laser in the Institute of Applied Physics RAS.<ref name="rg"/><ref>{{cite journal|author1=E.A. Khazanov|author2=A.M. Sergeev|year=2008|title=Petawatt laser based on optical parametric amplifiers: their state and prospects|journal=[[Physics-Uspekhi]]|volume=51|issue=9 |pages=969–974|doi=10.1070/PU2008v051n09ABEH006612|s2cid=250800366 |url=https://ufn.ru/en/articles/2008/9/h/|url-access=subscription}}</ref>
